alt: Aerial view from Sky 5 helicopter of the DuSable Lake Shore Drive drawbridge stuck in the raised position over the Chicago River with water spraying across the steel span from a Chicago Fire Department fireboat below
story: Chicago's DuSable Lake Shore Drive bridge, already rated structurally deficient and 'intolerable' in federal inspections, was raised for the Spirit of Chicago dinner yacht on September 2, 2026, in 96°F heat; the steel spans thermally expanded, couldn't close, and a Chicago Fire Department fireboat had to spray thousands of gallons of water on the span to cool it back down — blocking all traffic for over four hours.
why_funny: Officials raised a bridge they already knew was broken, for a dinner cruise, in extreme heat, and the only fix available was to put a literal fireboat on the river to cool off the not-on-fire bridge.
